technical.summary: XOM shows strong trend structure with price above all major moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions across RSI/Stochastic with bearish stochastic cross and neutral sector backdrop limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: XOM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 90 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior members with small amounts; market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming conviction or news sentiment data.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (287), FOMC decision imminent (0 days), and earnings in 90 days create compounded uncertainty for energy sector positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-SMA with ADX trending and OBV rising provides structural uptrend confirmation, while market fear (38/100) creates contrarian opportunity for energy sector mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI/Stochastic conditions with bearish stochastic cross, inverted yield curve recession signal, VIX crisis levels, imminent FOMC decision, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create compounded risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows uptrend confirmation (price above 200-SMA, ADX trending, OBV rising) and market fear presents contrarian opportunity, but overbought conditions with bearish stochastic cross and zero fundamental conviction make entry timing poor.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal combined with VIX crisis levels and imminent FOMC decision create macro headwinds that could trigger sharp energy sector reversal despite technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding XOM with 44 existing Energy positions (13% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and warrant skip decision.
